description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
vibe: Multi-agent-safe, type-strict, no-fluff engineering with explicit guardrails for every destructive action.
highlights: Multi-session git safety: only stage files you changed, never `git add -A`, never `git reset --hard` or `--no-verify`.
Erasable TypeScript only (Node strip-only mode): no enums, namespaces, parameter properties, or `import =`.
No inline/dynamic imports; top-level imports only, and never guess external API types — check node_modules.
Dependency changes treated as reviewed code: exact pins, `--ignore-scripts`, undici changelog review, shrinkwrap allowlist.
Never modify generated files directly (`models.generated.ts`); edit the generator script and regenerate.
assessment: This file reads like a senior maintainer's operational contract rather than a style guide: it encodes failure modes (parallel agent sessions stomping git state, lifecycle-script supply-chain risk, non-erasable TS breaking strip-only runtimes) as hard rules. The insistence on reading files in full before wide changes, answering questions before editing, and stating agreement/disagreement explicitly reflects a bias toward correctness and honest communication over velocity theater. It is unusually strong on blast-radius control — every destructive or irreversible action has a named prohibition or an explicit user-confirmation gate.
